A LETTER FOR YOU♡WITH ALL MY LOVE

Happy Birthdayyyyy,
en chella ammuuuu!

Happy Birthdayyyyy, en chella ammuuuu! 🥹❤️🫂🎂

Sinduuuu maaaaaa…

Enna solli start panrathune theriyala dii. 😂❤️

Usually naan unkitte pesumbothu edhavadhu sollite iruppen. Sometimes romba pesuven, sometimes loosu maari pesuven, sometimes sanda poduven, sometimes summa unna paathukitte irukkanum pola irukkum.

Aana inniku… un birthday ku unkitte en manasula irukkuratha sollanum nu aasai.

First of all, thank you for being born, dii. 🥹❤️

Because nee indha ulagathula porakkalana, oru naal en life la Sindhu nu oru ponnu vandhu, ivlo azhagana feelings ellam enakku kuduppa nu naan therinjirukkave maaten.

One year ku mela aagiduchu ma, namma oruthara oruthar therinju.

Indha time la naan unna neraya vidhama paathirukken.

Sirikkura Sindhu va…

Kurumbu panra Sindhu va…

Sanda podura Sindhu va…

Kovapadura Sindhu va…

Silent ah irukkura Sindhu va…

Ellarukkagavum yosikkura Sindhu va…

Sometimes thanakkullaye neraya vishayangal vechukittu kashtapadura Sindhu va…

And dii, indha ellathulayum enakku pudichathu nee thaan. ❤️

Konja naal munnadi nee enkitte oru vishayam ketta la…

“Naan panra sila vishayangal nala unakku enna pudikkama poirumonu bayama irukku…”

Ammuu, andha vaarthaigal innum en manasula irukku dii.

Adhukku naan innum onnu sollanum.

Enakku oru perfect Sindhu venam ma. Enakku en Sindhu thaan venum.

Nee eppavum happy ah irukkanum nu illa.

Nee eppavum enkitte pesitte irukkanum nu illa.

Nee eppavum ellathayum correct ah pannanum nu illa.

Unakkum un life irukku, family irukku, responsibilities irukku, dreams irukku, kashtangal irukku.

Adhellam naan purinjikka kathukkanum dii.

Sometimes namma rendu perukkum misunderstandings varalam. Sanda varalam. Naanum thappu pannalam, neeyum thappu pannalam.

Aana appadi nadakkumbothu, oruthara oruthar purinjikka try pannuvom ma.

Because love na happy moments mattum illa. Kashtamana moments layum oruthara oruthar purinjikka kathukkurathu thaan. 🫂❤️

And Sindu ma…

Nee busy ah irukkumbothu naan unna miss pannuven dii.

Romba miss pannuven. 😂❤️

Aana andha missing feeling kooda enakku pudikkum.

Because appothaan enakku thonum…

“Adei Gopi, indha chinna ponnu un life la evlo periya idam pudichirukka!” 🥹

Sometimes un oru chinna message en whole day ah change pannidum.

Un voice kekkumbothu enakku theriyamale smile vandhudum.

And nee sirikkumbothu…

Ammmaaaaa, andha sirippu! 😭❤️

Enakku adha epdi explain panrathune theriyala dii.

Unakku theriyuma, naan astronomy, stars, galaxies, universe pathi ellam romba yosippen.

Indha universe evlo perusu nu ninaikkumbothu namma rendu perum evlo chinnavanga nu thonum.

Aana andha periya universe la, kodi kodi manushanga irukkura indha ulagathula…

Naan unna meet pannirukken.

Namma pesirukkom.

Sirichirukkom.

Sanda pottirukkom.

Oruthara oruthar miss pannirukkom.

And slowly, nee en life la romba special aana oru person ah maaritta.

Adhu enakku romba azhagana vishayam dii. 🌌❤️

Ammuu, indha birthday la naan unakku expensive gifts ela ila......Aana naan unakku onnu solla virumburen.

Naan unna innum nalla purinjikka aasapaduren.

Un dreams ah kekkanum.

Un happiness ah celebrate pannanum.

Nee kashtapadumbothu un feelings ah dismiss pannama kekkanum.

Naan thappu pannina adha accept panni correct pannikanum.

And namma rendu perum nammaloda own life layum grow aaganum.

Because dii, naan unna love panrathu un life ah enakkaga maathurathukkaga illa.

Nee neeya irundhukitte, nee aasapadura ellathayum achieve panratha paakkanum nu enakku romba aasai. ❤️

Indha pudhu vayasu unakku neraya happiness kondu varanum.

Un health nalla irukkanum.

Un dreams ellam konjam konjama reality aaganum.

Nee un mela innum confidence vechukkanum.

And nee unna pathi yosikkumbothu, unakkulla irukkura nalla vishayangalaiyum paakkanum.

Because Sindu ma…

Nee enakku mattum special illa. Nee unakkagave romba valuable aana oru person. 🥹❤️

One more thing dii…

Naan unkitte adikkadi solluven la…

“Enakku unna pudikkum Sindu ma.”

Adhu oru habit ah sollura vaarthai illa dii.

Every day, unna pathi pudhusa edhavadhu therinjikkumbothu, andha feeling innum konjam deep aaguthu.

And naan unkitte irundhu kathukkura vishayangalum neraya irukku.

So thank you, ammuu.

For your smiles.

For your silly little fights.

For your care.

For your honesty.

For trusting me enough to share your fears.

And most importantly…

For being Sindhu. Just Sindhu. ❤️

Indha birthday la naan unakku oru chinna universe create pannirukken dii.

Adhula irukkura ovvoru star um, ovvoru memory um, ovvoru little surprise um unakkaga.

Because indha periya universe la…

Enakku romba pudicha oru chinna ulagam irukku.

Adhu nee thaan, en Sindu ma. 🌍🌌❤️

Happy Birthdayyyyy, en chella kutty saithaan, en kurumbukari, en azhagana ammuuuu! 😭😂❤️🎂

Sirichitte iru ma.

Unakku pudicha maari vaazhu.

Un dreams ah chase pannu.

And never forget how much you matter.

I love you, Sindu ma. More than yesterday, and I'm still discovering new reasons every day. ❤️🫂

With all my love, all my kurumbu, and my whole heart,

Un Haranaaa…onda future husban ahhh!

Gopi ❤️🌌

you are my little universe.✧ ♡ ✧
✧

In this very big universe,
my favourite little world is you.

Made for Sindu Maa, with Gopi’s whole heart. ♡
